scripts.build:ios-ipa: npm run build && (test -d ios || npx cap add ios) && npx cap sync ios && node scripts/configure-ios-native.mjs && (if [ -d ios/App/App.xcworkspace ]; then xcodebuild -workspace ios/App/App.xcworkspace -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath ios/App/build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO; else xcodebuild -project ios/App/App.xcodeproj -scheme App -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath ios/App/build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO; fi) && rm -rf build_ipa && mkdir -p build_ipa/Payload && cp -R ios/App/build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/App.app build_ipa/Payload/ && (cd build_ipa && zip -r9 ../Chinta-iOS.ipa Payload)
